correctness.rationale: For a_n=1/[2(n-1)], attachment to the marked vertex and attachment to a leaf overlap with conditional probability a_n times its leaf indicator. Expanding the mixed product cancels the opposing a_n D_n L_n drifts and gives Delta C_n=a_n^2 E[D_n]E[L_n]-a_n q_n. The marginal updates give d_n=(2n-3)q_n and ell_n=[2(n-1)+4q_n]/3; substitution gives the stated increment, including cancellation at n=2 and strict positivity thereafter. Stirling and summation give the square-root constant and dividing by d_n gives 1/3. The Bernoulli update yields E[D_n^2]=2(n-1)-d_n; the leaf-variance recurrence telescopes after multiplication by n-1 and its forcing tends to 2/9, giving variance n/9. These constants give the Pearson prefactor and n^(-1/2) decay. Independent exact rational replay via python -B /workspace/checks/bounded.py evolved the reduced joint distribution of degree and leaf count and agreed with the covariance formula through n=32. That bounded check is not a proof for arbitrary n.
